name: ads-intel-pp-cli
description: Private paid media intelligence CLI for Google Ads, Meta Ads, Amazon Ads, tracking confidence, structural audits, cross-channel budget-shift views, and hardened exact-negative Google Ads apply.

novel_features.name: Account status header
novel_features.description: every output includes account/CID, status, date range, tracking confidence, and read-only mode

novel_features.name: Tracking confidence
novel_features.description: checks cost, conversion, revenue, and learning-phase readiness before optimization

novel_features.name: Deterministic audit catalog
novel_features.description: runs stable check IDs from a versioned JSON catalog with severity multipliers and PASS/WARN/FAIL bands

novel_features.name: Drafted negatives
novel_features.description: emits negative-keyword candidates as local draft artifacts; apply remains dry-run by default

novel_features.name: Hardened exact-negative apply
novel_features.description: adds only Google Ads exact-match negatives from confirmed wasted-spend drafts behind allowlist, cap, idempotency, snapshot, verification, audit, reversal, --live-approved, and typed confirmation gates

novel_features.name: Quick wins
novel_features.description: selects high/critical findings under 15 minutes by severity multiplied by impact

novel_features.name: Budget shift
novel_features.description: read-only cross-channel spend and revenue comparison

sources.name: meta
sources.planned_command: meta-ads-pp-cli sync --agent / insights get-account <id> --agent / fatigue --agent / learning --agent
